/**/.purpose: Dedicated fitted-profile H2/O2 ZND detonation base on the 12.5 mm, 5000-cell grid for split/ODE matrix runs.
/**/.reference: Use the observed-order fixed-mesh timestep-limit speed D0=2798.224963262598 m/s as the matrix baseline. The independent SDToolbox/Cantera CJ speed is 2836.381883789159 m/s.
/**/.spatialResolution: Uniform_01_5000.cgns with meshScale=0.0125 gives h=2.5 um and about 20 cells across the fitted 50.04 um induction length. Spatial convergence is deferred because this grid is already fine enough for the next split/ODE comparison.
/**/.timeStepMatrix: Use dtImplicit in [1e-7, 2e-7, 4e-7]. Set nTimeStep to [8500, 4250, 2125], respectively, so every row reaches tEnd=8.5e-4.
/**/.odeMatrix: Use ESDIRK2 (odeCode 204), U2R2 (411), and U2R1 (412). odeCode=0 and sourceStrangSplitting=0 below only make the base parseable; override the ODE method, split treatment, output path, dtImplicit, and nTimeStep for every recorded row.
/**/.initialization: The round-trip-safe fitted laboratory-frame ZND initializer is embedded directly in this case. Do not pass it through CLI overlays; CLI overrides are reserved for matrix axes and output controls.
/**/.execution: Launch rows from build/ with np=64 on the authorized direct-SSH runner. Vary only matrix controls through -k/-v overlays and record the exact command and hashes.

consoleMainOutputFormat: Time[{telapsed:.3f}] recTime[{trec:.3f}] rhsTime[{trhs:.3f}] commTime[{tcomm:.3f}] limTime[{tLim:.3f}] limTimeA[{tLimiterA:.3f}] limTimeB[{tLimiterB:.3f}]
consoleMainOutputFormatInternal: Time[{telapsedM:.3f}] recTime[{trecM:.3f}] rhsTime[{trhsM:.3f}] commTime[{tcommM:.3f}] limTime[{tLimM:.3f}] limTimeA[{tLimiterA:.3f}] limTimeB[{tLimiterB:.3f}]

exprs: var pert_y := cos(2 * pi * x[1] / Ly);
var pert_y_sin := sin(2 * pi * x[1] / Ly);
UExprtk[2] += A_v * pert_y_sin * exp(-dist / (2 * ind_len)) * clamp(0, dist / (0.1 * ind_len), 1);
